title: Lean-core wave 2: std JSON Schema validation in GMCP, OS probes without sysinfo
goal: Second wave of docs/lean-core.md. GMCP validates tool input and output schemas with crates/susi-gmcp/src/schema_check.rs, a standard-library draft 2020-12 subset that implements every keyword the tool catalog, the MCP schemas and the extension packs use and fails closed at registration on any other validation keyword; the jsonschema facade (29 third-party crates of exclusive reach in the pillar closure) leaves GMCP. Then sysinfo leaves susi-gemi, susi-config and susi-gawd-agents for std and OS probes. Also records the cross-host coordination design (docs/harness-coordination.md): claims, receipts and per-platform integration pointers as refs on origin, compare-and-swap publication, adopt of pushed branches.
